title: VoltEdge landing and Telegram lead server
summary: Static landing page for electrical installation services in Almaty with calculator, lead form, and a Node.js server that accepts leads and sends them to Telegram.

title: Lead form sends calculator data to backend
success_user_message: Заявка отправлена. К ней прикреплен расчет: <estimatedPriceFormatted>.
error_user_message: Не удалось отправить заявку. Проверьте, что backend запущен на http://localhost:3000 и доступен endpoint /api/leads.

title: Calculator data contract
notes: This payload is attached to the form automatically before submit and is sent to the server inside the lead payload.

endpoints.purpose: backend health check and Telegram env readiness
accept site leads and send Telegram message to owner

title: Server environment variables

variables.TG_KEY: Telegram bot token placeholder, never commit real token

security_note: Real .env is ignored by git and must not be committed.

title: Local smoke test
steps: git pull in the project root
in another terminal run python -m http.server 4173 --bind 127.0.0.1 from project root
fill calculator and submit the lead form
verify that Telegram owner receives the lead with calculator data

title: Callback buttons need Telegram update handling
details: The current server sends callback_data buttons, but it does not yet run Telegram polling or webhook handlers for callback_query. URL buttons such as WhatsApp, tel, and Mini App work without callback handling. Callback actions like take, transfer, stats, and main_menu require polling or webhook implementation.

title: Current repository data check
checked_items: Frontend lead form has a POST fetch to /api/leads
Frontend sends calculator payload with the form
